reason: planning stopped before any code was written: the plan still needed revising in the last round (round 3 of 3). I read land.rs, gh.rs (land_pr, Athena::land_pr, parse_remote) and athena-git's replay, and checked them against the plan. The approach is sound and starts where the fault starts. The only rewrite of the local branch after a merge is the resync_onto_merge call at gh.rs:1630. Removing it keeps every running job's base an ancestor of HEAD, so `plan` in land.rs still lands the job. Moving the squash-conflict fix into a cut of the pull request head onto the remote tip reuses Git::replay, which already skips commits that become empty, so one merge still lands one job. The new `source` field on PrLink keeps reruns from pushing again, and the fingerprint check before any push keeps the P5 and merged-unverified protections. Extending the scope to gh.rs is justified; Athena's own finding about it carries less weight because the fault lives there. The main gap is criterion 1's demonstration: Athena::land_pr cannot take a fake Remote or host. It builds GitRemote on "origin" and GhClient itself, requires a github.com remote URL, and has no existing test harness. As written, the producer would have to invent a seam or a remote setup that the plan does not describe. Smaller points: criterion 2 asserts something about B's head that conflicts with records commits, the signs_commits open question can be closed now, and the claim that clippy catches leftover dead code does not hold for pub items. Verdict: revise; the planner can fix all of these. Findings: minor: crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs is not among the reading's deliverables (files, crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs); major: The criterion 1 test cannot pass a fake Remote or host into Athena::land_pr as the plan describes (Demonstrations, Criterion 1; Decision 5; gh.rs:1519-1570); minor: The assertion that B's head holds only B's own commits conflicts with how replay works (Demonstrations, Criterion 2 ("B's head holds only B's own commits")); minor: The signs_commits open question can be closed now (Open questions (signs_commits reachability)); nit: The claim that clippy fails on leftover dead code does not hold for pub items (Demonstrations, Criterion 3 (fails without))
